messages:
Leah: quick idea  ship a 3-step mini-lab series + a concise OSS launch post. focus: demos that finish within 15 minutes, with a benchmark appendix.
Hector: +1. make the labs copy-paste friendly. include a tiny docker compose for the private deploy path.
June: I can write two tutorials: "Quickstart in 5" and "Integrate and optimize (20)". will add a small perf table.
Ravi: will capture perf: tokens/sec, p50 latency, and estimated $/1k tokens for default vs quantized. keep the appendix CSV in the repo.
Leah: marketing assets: 2 tweet cards, 1 hero image, a 60s demo clip. also a short checklist for contributors in the OSS post.
ops-bot: created task list: draft outlines, perf runs, design assets, closed beta invites. board: https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/mini-labs/kanban
June: propose we A/B test two headlines on the landing page: "Start in 5 minutes" vs "Save X% on inference cost". track conversions and time-to-first-run.
Leah: good. Hector  please prototype the docker example by Friday. Ravi  reserve infra for perf runs next Tue-Thu. sync Thu 10am.
